localBiteReport: The inshore bite around Choctawhatchee Bay and Destin is in excellent shape this week, with Capt. Adam Schroeder (Ignite The Bite Charters, Destin) calling it one of the best he has seen all year. Bait is now abundant and easy to find early in the morning, and redfish — both bull reds and slot fish — are the headline target, biting well around the Destin Bridge, Brooks Bridge, the jetties, and deeper docks on an outgoing tide, with croakers and spot minnows as preferred live baits. Flounder and speckled trout are also responding to the improved bait presence, and are frequently mixed in with the redfish bite around bridge structure. Water temperature is 86°F. This early-fall window is considered one of the more productive inshore periods of the year, with the fall mullet run expected to keep pushing more slot reds onto the flats through October.
